summary: yum_repository options: enabled, enablegroups, exclude packages, failovermethod, file name, gpgcheck, gpgkey URLs and group.
questions: How do I exclude packages from a yum repo?
How do I put several repos in one .repo file?
How do I enable GPG checking and set the key URL?
How do I add a repo but leave it disabled?

answer_card.title: yum_repository parameters (part 2)
answer_card.answer_md:
- `enabled`, `enablegroups`
- `exclude` (alias `excludepkgs`): globs allowed
- `file`: repo filename (no `.repo`), default `name`
- `gpgcheck`, `gpgkey` (URL or list)
- `failovermethod`: `roundrobin`/`priority`
